keystar.name: KeyStar
keystar.subtitle: Button Mapper
keystar.title: Buttons, reimagined.
keystar.description: Map your Android device's buttons to the things you do every day. Control music, open apps, run Tasker tasks, and build shortcuts that change with the app you're using.
keystar.shortDescription: Map volume, power, and navigation buttons to your own shortcuts. Add up to ten actions per button, with different actions for different apps.
compatibility: Android 8 or later. Available features can vary by Android version.
If it runs Android, it will run KeyStar.
Notifications and Read Logs are required. Other permissions are optional and requested when using specific features.
Volume button mapping is free. Power and navigation button mapping require a one-time purchase.
features: Ten ways to press
Single through quintuple presses, plus a long-press version of each.
Shortcuts for each app
Use contexts to give the same button different actions in individual apps and on the lock screen.
Dozens of built-in actions
Open apps, manage media playback, change system settings, launch digital assistants, perform system actions, and more.
Customised actions
Create your own touch sequences, run custom Tasker tasks, or invoke Android intents.
Keep familiar controls
Exclude apps such as Camera and Clock so their volume-button controls continue to work normally.
Fine-tune everything
Adjust standard and long press delays, haptic feedback, volume adjustment speed, and more.

penstar.name: PenStar
penstar.subtitle: S Pen Button Mapper
penstar.title: Air Actions, wherever.
penstar.description: Map S Pen clicks and Air Actions to your favourite actions, even in apps that don't provide their own Air Action support. Control media, navigate, or run your own touch sequence.
penstar.shortDescription: Give S Pen clicks and Air Actions a purpose in the apps you use. Create collections of gesture actions for one app or a group of apps.
compatibility: Android 8.1 or later. Available features can vary by Android version.
A Samsung device with Bluetooth S Pen support is required.
Notifications, Read Logs, and Accessibility are required. Other permissions are optional and requested when using specific features.
All features and up to two App Actions are free. More than two App Actions require a one-time purchase.
features: Make every gesture useful
Assign actions to clicks, double clicks, long clicks, directional gestures, pointy gestures, circles, and shake.
Air Actions for all apps
Use your S Pen to control apps even when their developers haven't implemented Air Actions.
Dozens of built-in actions
Open apps, manage media playback, change system settings, launch digital assistants, perform system actions, and more.
Customised actions
Create your own touch sequences, run custom Tasker tasks, or invoke Android intents.
Create multiple App Actions
Create App Actions, which are a set of actions for the buttons and gestures you choose for a collection of apps.
Backup and restore
Share individual App Actions with others or backup your entire configuration for safekeeping.
